title: The ratchet stick
summary: Rene offers to show a ratchet stick, which he says people copied for the market.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Well, we haven't covered about half of it yet. About to run. What about a ratchet stick? You want me to tell me about a ratchet stick?

Oh, yeah. A ratchet stick. I can show you. You know, knife. I said, you have a knife. I can show you at the end of this table with a ratchet stick. They actually had them on the market. They came out of the market. You know, at that time, there used to be fellas, I noticed, there used to be fellas that come around looking for different ideas. Of course, they wouldn't tell us, but they would tell the people, you know? The fellas come tell them. The fellas been around there looking for different ideas, you know? Mm-hmm. And I had made a ratchet stick, and I noticed about six or seven months after they had a real ratchet stick on the market. stuff
